prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 23 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1236; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred while the patient was changing lanes, reporting neck and low back pain with associated stiffness and muscle tightness. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported symptoms for a collision of this type. Examination revealed paraspinal muscle tenderness and restricted cervical and lumbar range of motion, which support a soft tissue strain of the neck and back. Neurological screening, including reflexes, sensation, and strength in both upper and lower extremities, was within normal limits. No prior injury or treatment to these body regions is known to this provider. Care consisted of 23 visits combining manual therapy, guided home exercise, and supervised stretching. Progress was steady, and visit frequency was reduced gradually as pain and mobility improved. Billing records reflect single entries for each service with no duplicate or repeated charges. The patient is now near baseline function with occasional discomfort during prolonged sitting. Continued home exercise and as-needed follow-up were recommended.
